objective: Demostrar con evidencia SQL READ ONLY que la configuracion canonica de notificaciones para Catalogo Ampliado fue materializada: provider >=2, templates >=2 y configs >=2. Validar identidad SQL canonica EDARSAHUB/HRLectura y devolver conteos y filas exactas sin DML, sin cambios de archivos y sin envios externos.

queries.name: sql_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS user_name;

queries.name: provider_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS provider_count FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') AND ((JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='email' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='smtp') OR (JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='whatsapp' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='twilio'));

queries.name: provider_rows
queries.sql: SELECT MongoId, ColeccionOrigen, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS canal, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') AS provider, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') AND ((JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='email' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='smtp') OR (JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='whatsapp' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='twilio')) ORDER BY canal, provider;

queries.name: template_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS template_count FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo')='catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp');

queries.name: template_rows
queries.sql: SELECT MongoId, ColeccionOrigen, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS canal, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo') AS codigo, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo')='catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') ORDER BY canal;

queries.name: config_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS config_count FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo')='catalogo_ampliado' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento')='DOCUMENTO_VENCIMIENTO' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modo_envio')='real';

queries.name: config_rows
queries.sql: SELECT MongoId, ColeccionOrigen, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS canal, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo') AS modulo, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento') AS evento, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') AS provider, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modo_envio') AS modo_envio, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_codigo') AS template_codigo, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.max_reintentos') AS max_reintentos, JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.ventana_duplicidad_minutos') AS ventana_duplicidad_minutos, Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo')='catalogo_ampliado' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento')='DOCUMENTO_VENCIMIENTO' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') ORDER BY canal;

constraints: No INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE DDL EXEC or stored procedure execution
No external EMAIL or WhatsApp sends
